source_span.section: 1. 手工业的发展与对外贸易的形成

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that Northern Song handicrafts surpassed earlier dynasties in scale, technical level, and the quantity and quality of products because the mode of economic operation had changed: most state-workshop artisans were now recruited and personally free, and private workshops operated more openly.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，北宋手工业生产规模、技术水平与产品数量和质量均胜过前朝，其原因是经济运行方式发生了变革：官营手工业的工匠大部分为招募而来、人身有了自由，民间作坊的经营也更为开放。

discussion_notes: 候选作 interpretation；候选跨度 L2606-L2614 含纹样设计总论、社会审美背景与图 7-17，断言分置 L2608 与 L2613，中间隔图注行，记 contiguous；二方连续、散点、团花等组织形式留在来源。

source_span.section: 3. 宋代丝织、染缬工艺的发展｜2）丝织纹样设计

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that Tang silk patterns were characterized by brilliance, luxury, and fullness, while the Song style was markedly cool, natural, and dignified; motifs such as the baoxiang flower, paired birds, and paired beasts declined, while realistic flowering branches, scrolling floral branches, and bird-and-flower motifs became dominant, with pale, soft colours and lifelike drawing.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，唐代丝织纹样以艳丽、豪华、丰满为特色，宋代则以清淡自然与端重为突出时代风格；宝相花、对鸟、对兽等纹样趋向衰退，写生折枝花、穿枝花及花鸟纹成为主要内容，色彩淡雅柔和、纹样逼真写实。

discussion_notes: 候选作 basic_fact，路由 factual；断言分置 L2617 与 L2619，中间隔 L2618 引《洛阳绅缙旧闻》“李装花”，记 contiguous；夹缬专门化与婺州唐仲友彩帛铺留在来源。

source_span.section: 3. 宋代丝织、染缬工艺的发展｜3）染缬工艺的发展

statement_en: Xia Yanjing notes that in the late Northern Song the openwork printing block changed from wooden block stamping to oiled bamboo paper, making printed patterns finer, and gum powder was added to the dye liquor to prevent bleeding. Because Southern Song maritime trade flourished, resist-dyeing techniques reached Europe and quickly replaced local pigment-and-oil painted printing.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖指出，北宋末年镂空印花版开始改用桐油竹纸代替以前的木版捺印，使印花纹饰更加精细；为防止染液渗化，还在染液里加入胶粉调成浆状后再印花。宋代因南方航海业兴盛，染缬工艺传到欧洲各国，并很快取代当地用油料加颜料调成的涂料印花。

discussion_notes: 候选作 interpretation；候选跨度 L2689-L2701 含市镇、幌子与《济南刘家功夫针铺》铜版，断言取 L2693 的商标萌芽段；张家造、湖州石家念二叔照子等标记留在来源。

source_span.section: 5. 雕版印刷与商业美术设计｜2）商业美术设计

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that petty commodity production became increasingly active in the Song, and after the Southern Song household workshops multiplied, bringing market competition; at first there were no trademarks or formal advertisements, only the maker's name stamped on goods—ceramic, lacquer, gold-and-silver, and bronze-mirror marks—which was the germ of Song commercial art and gradually developed into a trade.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，宋代小商品生产日趋活跃，南宋以后家庭手工业作坊繁多、商品竞争随之而来；最初没有商标和正式广告，只把生产者姓名用刻印图章的形式写在商品上，形成陶瓷、漆器、金银器、铜镜等标记，这是宋朝商业美术的萌芽，并逐步发展形成行业。

discussion_notes: 候选作 interpretation；候选跨度 L2730-L2735 含汴梁沿街设店、晋祠圣母殿、辽金建筑与砖石塔，断言取 L2734 的材模数与定额制；开封相国寺塔28种琉璃砖、定县瞭敌塔84米留在来源。

source_span.section: 7. 宋代建筑及家具设计｜1）建筑与建筑彩绘设计

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that Song timber-frame architecture adopted a module system based on the “cai” standard and a system of labour-and-material quotas, bringing a degree of standardization to architectural design and construction.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，宋代木构架建筑采用了以“材”为标准的模数制和工料定额制，使建筑设计施工达到了一定程度的规范化。

discussion_notes: 候选作 interpretation；断言分置 L2746（结构转变与线脚）与 L2764（为元明清奠基），中间隔家具品种、拼合梁实例与图注，记 contiguous；束腰、牙条、罗锅枨、霸王枨、矮老、龟脚、马蹄足等构件名留在来源。

source_span.section: 7. 宋代建筑及家具设计｜2）家具

statement_en: Xia Yanjing argues that Song furniture replaced the box-and-lotus-panel construction with a post-and-beam frame, widely applied mouldings and built-up beams, and that its formal and structural innovations laid the foundation for Yuan, Ming, and Qing furniture.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，宋代家具以梁柱式框架结构取代箱形壶门结构，并大量应用线脚与拼合梁做法，其造型与结构创新为元、明、清家具发展奠定了基础。

discussion_notes: 候选作 attribution，按类型映射路由 factual；“开创了彩瓷的先声”是作者的技术史定位，随文保留而不另升为 evaluative；金代定窑砂圈叠烧、磁州窑宋加彩、耀州窑印花留在来源。

statement_en: Xia Yanjing notes that Jin dynasty Jun ware showed red patches on celadon glaze, heralding the beginning of polychrome porcelain.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖指出，金代钧窑在青釉上显现红斑，开创了彩瓷的先声。

source_span.section: 8. 辽和金时期的艺术设计｜6）金代银铜及铁制器工艺的形成与发展

statement_en: Xia Yanjing holds that Jin silver, bronze, and iron work benefited from improved state smelting and the growth of private iron making, and that both its casting and smelting techniques and vessel forms had surpassed those of the Northern Song.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，金代的银铜及铁制器工艺得益于官营冶铸业的提高与民间冶铁业的发展，其铸冶工艺水平和器皿造型样式都已超过北宋。

discussion_notes: 候选作 interpretation，但断言主体是制作水平与宋瓷的高下比较，按以评价为主改路由 evaluative；候选跨度 L2870-L2887 含活字印刷知识链接与西夏瓷器釉色、器形、圈足特征，断言取 L2879 的总评。

source_span.section: 9. 西夏时期的艺术设计｜2）西夏的瓷器工艺

statement_en: Xia Yanjing holds that although Western Xia porcelain included distinctive fine pieces, overall its production level was not high and quality was unstable, so it could not be mentioned in the same breath as Song porcelain.
statement_zh: 夏燕靖认为，西夏瓷器虽有特色精品，但总体制作水平不高、质量不稳定，与宋瓷不可同日而语。
